subject: Request: short runway buffer + credits for RetrofitHQ POC
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex@retrofithq.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodai.com>
Date: Sun, 19 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC sprint stalled — request for short runway buffer and credits

Hi team,

Quick update from our side — our integration lead hit a blocker with the event mapping for the webhook adapter. The engineering fix is small, but the fix needs a test environment that we can't fully reproduce on our side (it appears to be related to an auth token rotation in the staging connector).

We have attached the integration logs (integration-log-20280518.txt) and a short note from our eng lead that explains the steps. The upshot: we expect a 7–10 day delay to finish verification and end-to-end tests.

Because the delay pushes us past the POC demo window, we wanted to ask two favors:
- A 14-day extension to our sandbox access (so we don't lose the environment state we rely on)
- A small sandbox credit top-up (~10k tokens equivalent) so our engineers can run the additional full-stack tests without interrupting the current quota

If it helps, we are prepared to sign a short SOW (1–2 pages) committing to a demo/rollout milestone at the end of the extended window. If you want us to route that to legal immediately, happy to do so.

Appreciate any help — this POC matters for our decision next quarter.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Senior Product Manager
RetrofitHQ

On Sun, May 19, 2028 at 09:12 AM RetrofitHQ Integration <eng+integration@retrofithq.com> wrote:
> See attached logs

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodai.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex@retrofithq.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodai.com>
Date: Sun, 19 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC sprint stalled — request for short runway buffer and credits

Alex —

Thanks for the quick note and for sending the logs. I skimmed the attachment and the pattern looks like a token refresh timing edge coupled with an unexpected 401 path in the adapter. Understandable and something our SDK team has seen before.

Short answer: we can likely help. Before I put this up for formal approval I need to confirm two things with engineering and billing:
1) Can engineering verify this is a config/token timing issue (not a longer architectural change)?
2) What is the minimal amount of sandbox credit that will let Retrofit run the full regression suite without repeated interruptions?

Proposed immediate action (fast path):
- Internal provisional approval: grant a 14-day sandbox extension and 12k token-equivalent sandbox credit from our customer success discretionary pool. This is conditional on engineering sign-off.
- If engineering confirms the issue is a quick config fix, we ask Retrofit to sign the short SOW you mentioned (SOW-shortform-retrofit-draft.pdf). That helps finance tie the extension to a near-term milestone.

Marissa — can you confirm if we have the discretionary credit bandwidth for a ~12k top-up and if we should route this through billing ops?
David — could you or someone on runtime check the logs below and confirm this is indeed a token rotation edge case? If so we can expedite a sandbox patch.

Mateo
Head of Sales, Platform
Redwood Inference

-----Original message-----
From: Alex Turner <alex@retrofithq.com>
Sent: Sunday, May 19, 2028 9:12 AM
To: mateo_alvarez@redwoodai.com
Subject: POC sprint stalled — request for short runway buffer and credits

(see above)

From: Tara Singh <tara@retrofithq.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC sprint stalled — request for short runway buffer and credits

Hi Mateo / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick reply and the proposed path. A couple of clarifications from our engineering manager:
- The logs point to token stewardship in our staging accounts; the change required is a change to our rotation window and re-issuing the staging keys (takes ~1 full working day to coordinate with our infra team).
- The regression job we're running is expensive because it spins a handful of synthetic conversation flows against a snapshot of production traffic; the quota burn estimate Alex shared is conservative so 12k sounds reasonable.

We can sign the 1–2 page SOW immediately and will prioritize the infra ticket if you can confirm the extension and sandbox credit. If you prefer, we can also sign a simple acceptance criteria doc that describes the demo milestone (screens, sample prompts, latency target).

Tara Singh
Head of Integrations
RetrofitHQ

Attachment: integration-log-20280518.txt

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodai.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal_ops@redwoodai.com>, Billing Ops <billing_ops@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Approve short runway + credit (RetrofitHQ POC)

Team —

Internal decision after quick check: approve the provisional support described below to keep the POC on track. This is internal-only; we'll confirm externally after billing + legal have a short SOW.

Decision summary:
- Approve a 14-day sandbox extension (effective immediately).
- Approve a one-time 12,000 token-equivalent sandbox credit from the Sales discretionary pool.
- Attachments: SOW-shortform-retrofit-draft.pdf (please review)

Conditions & next steps:
1) Billing Ops: please provision the sandbox extension and apply the credit code RWD-PROT-RETRO-12000 to RetrofitHQ account. Confirm when complete.
2) Legal Ops: please do a quick review of the short SOW and remove any clauses that extend commercial commitments — this should be an execution-only confirmation for the POC milestone.
3) Mateo: once billing/legal confirm, please send the note below to Alex & Tara (I drafted a short external email for you to send).
4) David: engineering to validate the logs and confirm both that the issue is a token rotation edge and that the extra quota will be sufficient. If engineering discovers a larger problem, we will revisit.

Draft external sentence (for Mateo to send):
"We can confirm a 14-day extension and a one-time 12k sandbox credit; please sign the attached 1-page SOW and we'll enable the credit immediately. Billing will follow up with the code.

Marissa
Senior Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference"
